name: Yoshizawa Takeo
source:
An easy going man who fell in love at first sight with Miyuri. He works in an office. Has a huge penis, and have lots of sex friends as well. 

[Translated from [url=http://www.alicesoft.com/tsumamigui3/chara/sub.html]Official Site[/url]]

[spoiler]In NTR route with [url=https://vndb.org/c43230]Miyuri[/url]. Takeo conquers Miyuri with his sexual skills and convinces Mayuri to have his child and raising it as Kazuto's. True father to [url=https://vndb.org/c96717]Takashi[/url][/spoiler]

[spoiler]Side story Takeo gives up on Miyuri after discovering his Dad is having sex with her at the office. Takeo then aims for Ai and gets trained by Sumire on how to please her.[/spoiler]
